do: Use at least 48x48px touch targets with 8px spacing

keywords: loading state async button spinner skeleton
do: Show skeleton or inline loading within 100ms of action
dont: Leave the UI frozen without feedback

do: Show inline error next to the field with fix instructions
dont: Show only a generic toast or color change

do: Use persistent visible labels above inputs
dont: Use placeholder as the only label

do: Keep primary nav consistent and show current location
Respect prefers-reduced-motion and animate transform/opacity only
dont: Animate width/height/top/left or ignore reduced motion

do: Keep text contrast at 4.5:1 or higher (3:1 large text)
dont: Use light gray text on white for body copy

do: Show a visible focus ring and keep logical tab order
Explain what is missing and give a primary next action
Offer undo or a confirm step naming the object being removed
dont: Delete irreversibly on a single click

do: Use 100dvh and safe-area insets on mobile
dont: Use 100vh that hides content behind browser bars

do: Provide one primary CTA per view with clear secondary styles

keywords: font size readable body line length
do: Use 16px minimum body and 60-75ch line length
dont: Use body text below 14px or full-width paragraphs

do: Use one consistent SVG icon set with accessible labels
Reserve image dimensions and lazy-load below the fold
dont: Let images shift layout on load

do: Provide sort filter and sticky header for dense tables
